text:
maya: Hey folks, fresh org invite accepted and following the quickstart but getting 403 on the first API call. Key was copied from the console. Any tips? :confused:

maya: curl I used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-medium","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}]}'
```

lee: Did you attach a billing method? We gate first requests for trial activation in some cases.

billing-bot: Workspace "trial-maya" billing status: AWAITING_PAYMENT_METHOD. API access limited until a payment method or trial is activated. See https://console.redwood.ai/workspace/billing to start trial.

maya: Weird — the console showed an initial "Start trial" banner when I accepted, then disappeared. I didn't get prompted to add a card.

infra-bot: There was a recent race where the invite flow creates the org then enqueues an activation job. If you hit the API before the job completes, the auth check returns 403. We should return a clearer error for workspace not active.

lee: Also FYI our SDKs intentionally do NOT retry on 403. But the quickstart wrapper logs a generic "attempting retry" for network/error flows which confuses people when they see it for 403.

maya: I saw a single "retrying request" in the Node quickstart logs and panicked thinking it sent two messages. Can confirm waiting ~1 min and then calling again works — got 200 and message back.

lee: Short-term: re-open billing page and click "Start trial" or wait 30-90s after invite accept. Long-term: we'll (1) block invite accept until activation completes, (2) change 403 to a structured error code workspace_not_active with human hint, and (3) remove the noisy retry log for non-retriable errors in the sample wrapper.

maya: Thanks — that would save a lot of support noise. Happy to test any fix.

devex-bot: Ticket created DEVEX-2468: "Invite flow activation race + quickstart retry noise" assigned to @lee and @infra. Link: https://tracker.redwood.ai/DEVEX-2468 :white_check_mark:

maya: tagging this thread for others onboarding. cheers! :rocket:
